entities.name: Cotton Monoculture and Aral Sea Catastrophe
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The intensification of cotton monoculture ('white gold'), the massive diversion of the Amu Darya and Syr Darya for irrigation, and the beginning of the Aral Sea's catastrophic shrinkage — one of the worst environmental disasters in history.
